events.title: Major Optimizations and Polish Added
events.summary: Hello! Based on feedback from the Demo release I have made some major quality of life updates to the game. Visual UpdatesFor the visual changes I added some new unit targeting markers to help you figure out what you are attacking. I also added a background to the battle map so it does not just look like it is floating on nothing. Scenario UpdatesBased on collected statistics, a lot of players were having issues winning a couple of the scenarios(0% win rate so far), I have made them a bit easier

events.title: Demo Live for Steam's Next Fest
events.summary: Hello! After months of work and improvements, I have released a demo of Drums & Steel! I have been focusing on polishing the look and feel of the menus, interactions, and visuals to put my best foot forward towards the gaming community. I have created scenarios and tutorials for you to test the game our and decide for yourself! I will also be taking part in Steam's Next Fest! Best,Outerbounds

events.title: Demo Release for Steam's Next Fest
events.summary: Hello! After months of work and improvements, I plan to be releasing a demo of Drums & Steel very soon! Over the last weeks I have been focusing on polishing the look and feel of the menus, interactions, and visuals to put my best foot forward towards the gaming community. Keep a lookout for the demo release as it should be coming in the next couple days leading up to the Steam's Next Fest!Best,Outerbounds
